Introduction

This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on 
an annually bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the above title block

The first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed El-Moghazy, reviewed by eng. 
Mohamed Abbass, tested by eng. Magdy Mohamed El-Shabrawy, revised by eng. Adel 
Abdel Kader El-Naggar EDEPC inspection & quality control engineer, and approved by 
eng. Tarek Youssef Ali head sector of Ayon Mousa PS.

This 
document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil EDEPC inspection & quality control 
general director, MPIS coordinator and 
certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC admin & financial inspection & 
quality control's general director and supervisor of inspection & quality 
control head sector
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staffmust carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear the appropriate safety equipment as safety shoes and helmet

All maintenance work must be done with both primary and control power circuits 
 are de-energized
Inspect the panel board once every year or after any severe electrical faults

items: Complete tool kit
Brush, vacuum cleaner
Megger1000 volt or 2500 volt
Lubricant 0282A2048P009

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out
Load Centre Cells
400V Load Centre Breakers
Check the breaker operating mechanism.

Check the integrity of all electrical and 
 mechanical interlocks.
Examine switch operating mechanism.

Whenever possible, check all devices for 
 missing or broken parts, proper spring tension, free movement, rusting or 
 corrosion and dirt.

Adjust, clean and lubricate or replace parts 
 as required.

Use a clean non metallic, light grease parts

If no instructions are given on the devices sliding copper contacts
